detail.summary: Delivered both independent deliverables. Wrote out/sum.txt containing the integer sum 44 (from data/a.txt: 17+-4+23+8), out/words.txt containing the 5 unique words from data/b.txt in case-sensitive lexicographic order (Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum), and out/notes.txt with a one-line description of both results. Computed results with real commands and verified all outputs by re-deriving them and diffing.
evidence: tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' < data/b.txt | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u -> 5 unique tokens
LC_ALL=C sort -u (tokens) -> Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum; diff vs out/words.txt succeeded ('words.txt OK (case-sensitive order)')
cat out/sum.txt / out/words.txt / out/notes.txt and ls -l out/ confirmed contents and file sizes
od -c out/words.txt confirmed byte order A (0x41) before a (0x61)
